title: Cortex Agent Workspace Runtime Layout
description: Frozen descriptor of the runtime layout slice visible to a single workspace identity. Mirrors the resolver output for that workspace: project-level portable namespaces, the per-host binding slot, and the per-instance slice. Two workspaces with equal `workspace_id` MUST describe the same logical structure; per-host absolute paths are confined to `host_binding_ref` and may legitimately differ across machines.

runtime_dir.description: Logical segment inside `.agent/`. Combined with `workspace_id` to form the portable-runtime slice.

host_binding_ref.description: Logical reference to the local binding record. The `<machine_id>` placeholder is intentional — the absolute filesystem path stays inside the binding file.

worktree_instance_ref.description: Logical reference to the per-instance slice. The `<workspace_instance_id>` placeholder keeps the per-instance location stable across hosts.

legacy_root_ref.description: Read-only reference to the legacy runtime root. Writers MUST NOT target this path once the new layout is activated.
